title: Vanishing of the high image-filtration steps in etale hypercohomology
statement: For a scheme X, a complex K of abelian etale sheaves, and integers p < q, any x in H^p(X,K) in the image filtration from complexes supported in degrees at least q is zero. Here image-filtration membership means there exist a complex T with T^n=0 for n<q, a map f:T→K and y in H^p(X,T) with H^p(f)(y)=x. This is the image from the stupid truncation at q: any such f factors through the stupid truncation, and its inclusion is itself a witness.

source.place: Lemma 13.21.3, first spectral sequence and finite abutment filtration

proof.text: Choose witness T,f,y. Establish T.IsStrictlyGE q from the support condition. Apply Mathlib CochainComplex.Plus.modelCategoryQuillen.exists_quasiIso_injective T q to obtain a quasi-isomorphic complex J of injectives with the same strict lower bound. CochainComplex.isKInjective_of_injective J q makes J K-injective. Global sections sends zero objects to zero objects, so the termwise global-sections complex M has the same lower bound. The source-library proved isomorphism Functor.rightDerivedFunctorObjQIso J, composed with the image of the quasi-isomorphism, identifies RΓ(T) with Q(M). DerivedCategory.isZero_of_isGE shows its p-th homology is zero when p<q. Transport along the homology isomorphism, use AddCommGrpCat.subsingleton_of_isZero to get y=0, and conclude by map_zero. These are direct applications of proved Mathlib and source-library tools; no spectral-sequence theorem or other postponed proof is used.

lean.statement:
theorem eq_zero_of_inEtaleHypercohomologyFiltration
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (K : CochainComplex (Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) ℤ)
    (p q : ℤ) (hpq : p < q)
    (x : (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} X p).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))
    (hx : InEtaleHypercohomologyFiltration X K p q x) : x = 0
